Start date: 1064-09-19  
Add 40 weeks = 280 days.  
Add 4 days → total 284 days.  

1064 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100).  
From 1064-09-19:  
Remaining days in Sep: 11  
Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31 → total 103 days to end of 1064.  
284 − 103 = 181 days into 1065.  

1065 is not leap (1065 ÷ 4 = 266.25).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 181 days?  
Jan 31 (31), Feb 28 (59), Mar 31 (90), Apr 30 (120), May 31 (151), Jun 30 (181).  
181st day of 1065 = June 30.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1065-06-30
